Common questions

The things people ask first.

Short answers. If yours isn't here, there's a form at the bottom of this page and it comes straight to me.

The screen has stopped answering me
Look at the top of the screen for a shut padlock. That's the lock, and while it's shut nothing else responds. Tap the padlock and everything works again. Boxes leave here with the lock switched off, so if you're seeing this, somebody turned it on in settings. What the lock is for →
It went dark on its own
That's meant to happen. It dims after a minute of nobody touching it and blanks after ten. Tap the glass and it comes straight back to the screen you were on. It won't do it in the middle of a tag cooldown.
How do I turn it off?
There's no power switch. Off is the top right of the menu: it blanks the screen and a tap wakes it. Between game nights, plug it in the way you would anything else with a battery in it.
How do I charge it, and where is the cable?
Any USB-C phone charger works. A cable isn't included. The battery tile says Charging while it's plugged in, and shows the percentage again once you unplug it.
Taps are landing in the wrong place. How do I fix touch?
Plug the box into a computer and open Fix touch in Chrome or Edge. Press Reset to factory first, which fixes most problems. If it's still off, use Calibrate by hand and tap the three dots on the box.
Why does the battery percentage move around?
The box works out its charge from the battery's voltage, and that voltage dips while the screen is bright and recovers when it dims. So it can read a little lower while you're playing and a little higher a minute after you stop. It's a guide, not an exact count. While it's charging the box can't tell the level at all, which is why it just says Charging.
Do I need an app, an account or wifi?
No app and no account. The box works on its own with no wifi at all. If you'd rather play on a phone, there's a web version, and that one needs the internet.
Can I play it on my phone?
Yes, if you own a box. Tap Play at the top of this page and type in your box's code. To find the code, open Info on the box and tap the arrow past the rule pages until you reach Play on your phone. You only type it once per phone. It's the same game, same words, and the phone gets passed around instead of the box.
How many people can play?
Three to fifteen, and you choose how many of them are imposters. Two people doesn't work: there's nobody to hide among.
Does the imposter know they're the imposter?
Yes. Their card says so, and gives them a one word hint instead of the real word. Turn the hint word off in setup if you want to make their life much harder.
Can I put my own words in it?
Not yet. It has 450 words across eighteen categories built in, and it won't repeat one inside sixteen rounds.
Can it get wet?
No. It's not water resistant and there's a battery in it. Keep it dry, and keep it out of a hot car.
It got warm while charging
Normal, and it should be mildly warm at most. If it's ever hot enough to be unpleasant to hold, unplug it and message me.
Something is actually broken
Tell me. The form at the bottom of this page reaches me directly, and there's a box to tick if you want a reply. Go to the form →
